custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active tracked part, part A, for this test, with 5 in its bin.
  • Make sure no Cycle count is running on the Inventory list.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425600-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425600-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • A cycle count is running when the Inventory list shows a Count column with Save and Cancel above it; click Cancel to stop it.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The count starts: the toolbar shows the count controls (the printer icon, Save, Cancel and "Count changes available") and part A has a Count box.
  • The three-dot actions button is not shown while the count runs, so Deactivate parts cannot be reached, and no checkbox column appears.

Step 3:

  • The count ends without saving and the three-dot actions button is back.

Step 4:

  • The menu lists "Cycle count", "Deactivate parts" and "Export".

Step 5:

  • The count starts again and the three-dot actions button is not shown.

Step 6:

  • Part A's Count box shows 5.

Step 7:

  • The count is saved and ends; part A still shows 5 Available.

Step 8:

  • The menu is back with "Cycle count", "Deactivate parts" and "Export".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S2-E4: “Cycle count and bulk status mode cannot both be on. While Cycle count runs, the actions menu is replaced by the count controls, so the bulk status entry cannot be reached until the count is saved or discarded. While bulk status mode is on, the menu does not offer Cycle count (S2-R10b).”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.
